body: 将上传的虚构岛屿地图转成古代羊皮纸藏宝图。保持海岸线、西部港口、北方三组山丘、中央城镇、东部池塘和东南棕榈滩的位置关系，改用手绘山脉、港口城堡、帆船、罗盘玫瑰、从港口经过城镇通往东南沙滩的虚线寻宝路线，在沙滩标大红X。古旧褐色墨线，羊皮纸，方图，无现代UI。

en.body:
## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. Upload the ordered synthetic reference images shown in the run before generating.

## Observed result

The crescent coastline, west harbor, three northern hills, central town and eastern pond are retained; a dashed route leads to the southeast X.

## Source

Independently adapted from the supplied design prompt collection, case 28. [Source](https://github.com/jamez-bondos/awesome-gpt4o-images/blob/main/README_en.md#case-91-google-maps-to-ancient-treasure-map). GPT Image returned no precise version identifier.

## 使用方法

复制本图实际使用的完整提示词。修改主体后属于尚未验证的新变体。生成前，按顺序上传运行记录中展示的合成参考图。

## 观察结果

月牙海岸、西港、北部三山、中央城镇与东侧池塘保留，虚线路线通向东南红X。
